# Proslogion

*[Anselm](../philosophers/anselm.md) · 1078 · *Proslogion**

A short treatise by [Anselm](../philosophers/anselm.md), written at the abbey of Bec, seeking a single argument to prove that God exists: the idea of "that than which nothing greater can be conceived". It is the origin of the argument Kant would call ontological.
